sub_graphs.title: EIP-8123: Gas Limit Cap Query Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Models the JSON-RPC query flow for discovering transaction gas limit caps

nodes.label: Client Needs Gas Cap Info
nodes.description: Wallet or tool needs to discover maximum transaction gas limit before transaction construction

nodes.label: Send eth_txGasLimitCap Request
nodes.description: Client sends JSON-RPC request with method eth_txGasLimitCap and empty params

nodes.label: Awaiting Node Response
nodes.description: Request sent, waiting for node to respond

nodes.label: Node Computes Effective Cap
nodes.description: Node calculates min(protocolCap, policyCap) as the effective limit

nodes.label: Gas Cap Retrieved
nodes.description: Client has received the gas limit cap value

nodes.label: No Finite Cap Exists
nodes.description: Node returned null indicating no finite cap

external_entities.name: Ethereum RPC Node
external_entities.description: Node providing the eth_txGasLimitCap RPC method

sub_graphs.title: EIP-8123: Gas Cap Computation Logic
sub_graphs.description: Models how nodes compute the effective transaction gas limit cap from protocol and policy constraints

nodes.label: Protocol Cap Defined
nodes.description: Active protocol rules define a maximum tx.gas (e.g., EIP-7825's 2^24)

nodes.label: No Protocol Cap
nodes.description: Protocol does not define a finite gas limit cap

nodes.label: Policy Cap Configured
nodes.description: Node operator has configured a local policy cap for mempool admission

nodes.label: No Policy Cap
nodes.description: Node has no local policy cap configured

nodes.label: Compute Minimum of Caps
nodes.description: Calculate min(protocolCap, policyCap) as the effective cap

nodes.label: Effective Cap Computed
nodes.description: The effective gas limit cap has been determined

nodes.label: Return Null
nodes.description: No finite cap exists, return null

sub_graphs.title: EIP-8123: Transaction Construction with Gas Cap
sub_graphs.description: Models how wallets use the gas cap information when constructing transactions

nodes.label: Wallet Preparing Transaction
nodes.description: User wallet is constructing a transaction and needs to set gas limit

nodes.label: Query Gas Cap
nodes.description: Wallet calls eth_txGasLimitCap to discover maximum allowed gas

nodes.label: Gas Cap Known
nodes.description: Wallet knows the maximum transaction gas limit

nodes.label: Estimate Gas Needed
nodes.description: Wallet estimates gas required for the transaction

nodes.label: Validate Against Cap
nodes.description: Check if estimated gas exceeds the cap

nodes.label: Transaction Within Cap
nodes.description: Transaction gas is within allowed limit

nodes.label: Transaction Exceeds Cap
nodes.description: Transaction requires more gas than cap allows

nodes.label: Warn User
nodes.description: Alert user that transaction cannot be submitted as-is

external_entities.name: Wallet User
external_entities.description: User interacting with wallet to send transaction

ambiguities.text: The relationship between protocolCap and policyCap is defined but it's unclear if nodes MUST enforce policyCap at the protocol level or only at mempool admission
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume policyCap is only for mempool admission policy, not consensus. Transactions above policyCap but below protocolCap could still be included by other nodes.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior when protocol cap changes (e.g., at a hard fork)
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the method returns the current effective cap at query time. Clients should re-query after known hard forks.

implicit_assumptions.description: The node is trusted to return accurate cap information
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious nodes could return incorrect caps, causing transaction failures or users to believe they can submit transactions that will be rejected

implicit_assumptions.description: Different chains (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon) have different protocol caps that clients need to discover
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If all chains had the same cap, this method would be unnecessary. The heterogeneous environment motivates this EIP.

implicit_assumptions.description: Wallets and tools will query this method instead of hardcoding gas limits
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If tools continue to use hardcoded values, they may construct invalid transactions or fail to utilize available gas
